title: CAD-Native Transformer Operators for AI-Aided Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2609.36806v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern engineering systems, from automobiles to aircraft, are designed by using precise, continuous parametric computer-aided design (CAD) models. Evaluating design changes through numerical simulation requires meshing the continuous geometry, a computationally expensive and often brittle process that can require manual intervention and replaces the continuous representation with a discrete approximation. Most neural surrogates accelerate the simulation, but inherit this representation gap by relying on meshes, point clouds, voxels, or other sampled approximations of geometry. We introduce CANTO, a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous CAD geometry to physical fields, without meshing the input geometry. We develop a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields, representing geometry through sequences of parametric patches. translated_title: 面向AI辅助工程的CAD原生Transformer算子
translated_abstract: 现代工程系统，从汽车到飞机，都是通过精确、连续的参数化计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型进行设计的。通过数值仿真来评估设计变更需要对连续几何体进行网格划分，这是一个计算成本高昂且往往脆弱的过程，可能需要人工干预，并且会用离散近似取代连续表示。大多数神经代理模型虽然加速了仿真，但由于依赖网格、点云、体素或其他对几何的采样近似，继承了这一表示鸿沟。我们提出了CANTO，这是一种直接从连续CAD几何映射到物理场的Transformer神经算子，无需对输入几何进行网格划分。我们建立了一个从几何流形到物理场函数空间的算子学习理论框架，通过参数化曲面片序列来表示几何体。CANTO实例化了这一框架……
tldr: 该论文提出CANTO，一种无需网格划分、直接从连续参数化CAD几何映射到物理场的Transformer神经算子，并建立了从几何流形到物理场函数空间的算子学习理论框架，弥补了传统仿真和神经代理模型中连续几何与离散表示之间的鸿沟。
en_tdlr: CANTO is a transformer neural operator that maps directly from continuous parametric CAD geometry to physical fields without meshing, supported by a theoretical framework for learning operators from geometric manifolds to function spaces of physical fields.
